title.narrative: Program to Strengthen Public Policy and Fiscal Management in Response to the Health and Economic Crisis Caused by COVID-19 in the Dominican Republic
Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Poltica Pblica y la Gestin Fiscal para la Atencin de la Crisis Sanitaria y Econmica Causada por el COVID-19 en Repblica Dominicana

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es fortalecer la eficiencia y la eficacia de la poltica pblica y la gestin fiscal para atender la crisis sanitaria y econmica causada por el COVID-19, mediante el diseo y la implementacin de medidas de poltica efectivas y fiscalmente responsables.

The general objective of the program is to strengthen the efficiency and the effectiveness of public policy and fiscal management to address the health and economic crisis caused by COVID-19, through the design and the implementation of effective and fiscally responsible policy measures.
Commitment in 2020-06-26
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2020
